summary: Lloyds Banking Group filed a Form 6-K announcing purchases of its own ordinary shares under existing buyback programmes, executed by broker Goldman Sachs International. From 17-21 August 2026, the company bought 60,656,333 shares at prices between 109.35 and 115.60 pence per share, with volume-weighted averages ranging from 109.8747 to 114.9789 pence. These shares are intended for cancellation, reducing outstanding capital. The purchases are part of programmes announced 30 January and 31 July 2026. This routine buyback disclosure represents capital returns to shareholders; no premium, advisor, or closing date applies. Watch for continued execution and cancellation impact on EPS.
